main_body: Round leaf canopy (rows ~1-30) on a single brown trunk with root flare (rows 30-46)
top_band: Canopy top: light-to-mid green mass at rows 1-10 reading as a rounded dome seen from above, highlights at upper left; no separate flat band, organic form
evidence: Organic tree: rounded canopy with lit upper dome and darker underside (rows 22-30) that shades the trunk, trunk with lit left and shaded right side and root flare. Reads as a volumetric 3/4 tree, not an elevation of a flat object. No hard front edge line, as expected for organic shapes.

style.evidence: Canopy has about 5 green steps with lighter clumps at upper left and mid-left and a dark underside, and the trunk has 3-4 brown steps with bark dots on the right. The outline is mostly near-black around the canopy edge and trunk, though it is darker green in places, so it reads as mixed. Compared with the references, whose leaf clumps are individually shaded with visible branches and root detail, the canopy here is a smooth blob with blocky pixel noise and no distinct leaf clusters or visible branches. The large trunk area and the dark bottom-right canopy are fairly flat. It is cleaner and simpler than the Beodeul references, so it feels thinner and more sticker-like.
